Container.Name: tiktok-favorites-archiver
Container.Overview:
Turns your TikTok data export into a local, browsable archive. Upload the export, and the app downloads your favorited videos through a Cobalt instance, stores them on disk, and serves a local feed and gallery with search, curation, and playback. Everything runs on your server; nothing is uploaded anywhere.
Requires a companion Cobalt container to resolve downloads. Install the "cobalt" template from this same repository first (or point COBALT_API_URL at an existing Cobalt instance), then set COBALT_API_URL below to its address.
You also need a TikTok data export (Settings, Account, Download your data) to feed the app. Downloaded media lands in the Downloads path below, so you can point Plex or Jellyfin at it directly.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web interface listens on.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where downloaded videos, slideshows, and audio are stored. Point Plex/Jellyfin at this folder.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: SQLite database and application state. Kept separate from the media folder.

Config.Name: COBALT_API_URL
Config.Description: URL of your Cobalt instance. Replace [unraid-ip] with your server's LAN IP if you installed the companion cobalt template on this server (it publishes port 9000). The archiver cannot download anything without it.

Config.Name: ALLOWED_HOSTS
Config.Description: Host header allowlist. '*' answers to any host name, which makes the WebUI work out of the box but weakens the app's DNS-rebinding guard. Strongly recommended: replace '*' with the names you actually use to reach this server, comma-separated, e.g. '192.168.1.20,tower.local'. Requests to loopback are always allowed. The app has no login, so do not expose this port beyond your trusted network.

Config.Name: RATE_MAX_CALLS
Config.Description: Max Cobalt API calls per RATE_PERIOD seconds. Keep the resulting rate comfortably below Cobalt's RATELIMIT_MAX budget (4 calls/second = 240/minute against the companion template's 600/minute).

Config.Name: SONG_ID_RATE_MAX_CALLS
Config.Description: Shazam song-identification calls per SONG_ID_RATE_PERIOD seconds. Shazam throttles sustained traffic, so keep this gentle for bulk identification.
